subject: planner: fix tiflash path will be identified as table dual (#49338)
summary: Reviewed diff vs parent (5bd02673af37…) limited to planner. Change in `pkg/planner/core/stats.go` makes `DataSource.derivePathStatsAndTryHeuristics()` pre-derive the TiFlash table path when `preferTiFlash` is set, and then keep that derived TiFlash path even if heuristic pruning selects a TiKV path. This addresses the root failure mode where an un-derived TiFlash path can retain `Ranges == nil/len==0`, which later causes `skylinePruning()` / `findBestTask()` to short-circuit to `PhysicalTableDual` on the first empty-range candidate. Checked invariants: `preferTiFlash` is only set when a TiFlash access path exists (`DataSource.setPreferredStoreType`), so keeping/appending the cached `tiflashPath` does not introduce a plausible nil-path crash. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness/SQL semantics/consistency/compatibility within scope.
